---

contributor to MP (1882-8)

She first seems to have entered CMY’s life as an enthusiastic member of the Spider society, writing as the 'Muffin Man'.

Subsequently she assisted Lady Brabazon (later the Countess of Meath) in her charities; she lived at Ravensleigh, Betchworth, Surrey, daughter of Alfred Parr Cazenove and Louise. [LG Cazenove]
